Name: Button's Extra Books
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod adds new books that can be purchased from the Bookseller or gained via other means that grant you new powers, similar to the currently available miscellaneous power books. These are [i]not[/i] skill books; they do not increase your normal stats like fishing, farming, etc. (unless you have already read them, in which case they grant a minor increase to all skills).

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=5][b]Books[/b][/size]
Currently, this mod adds 15 books. Please see the spoiler section below to know what they do.

[spoiler]
[i]Artisans Guild Manual[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_ArtisanMachines.png[/img]
Cost: Free/100,000 (See How to Obtain)
Effect: Machines that produce artisan goods (cheese press, oil machine, etc.) will produce things 10% faster (configurable).
How to Obtain: [spoiler]Place 6 artisan goods in your grange display at the Stardew Valley Fair and place 1st. The Artisans Guild will send you the book in the mail the following day. Afterwards it can be bought from the Bookseller.[/spoiler]
[line]
[i]Beginner's Luck[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_Luck.png[/img]
Cost: 25,000.
Effect: A permanent, minor increase to luck (configurable).
How to Obtain: Bookseller.
[line]
[i]Big Melons![/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_GiantCrops.png[/img]
Cost: 30,000.
Effect: Giant crops now have a 5% chance to grow overnight instead of 1% (configurable).
How to Obtain: Bookseller from Year 2 onward.
[line]
[i]Winter Forestry[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_Trees.png[/img]
Cost: 20,000.
Effect: Trees will now continue to grow in the winter season.
How to Obtain: Bookseller.
[line]
[i]Book of Altruism[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_ExtraGifts.png[/img]
Cost: 50,000.
Effect: You are no longer limited to two gifts per week per person (though still limited to one per day).
How to Obtain: Bookseller from Year 3 onward.
[line]
[i]Friendship 202[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_Popularity.png[/img]
Cost: 35,000.
Effect: NPCs you are friends with will have a higher chance of sending you gifts in the mail.
How to Obtain: Bookseller after reading Friendship 101.
[line]
[i]Bus Driving for Dummies[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_BusDriving.png[/img]
Cost: 42,500.
Effect: You can drive the bus to Calico Desert all by yourself at any time.
How to Obtain: Bookseller after completing the Community Center/Joja Warehouse.
[line]
[i]Mr. Qi's Notebook[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_QiNotebook.png[/img]
Cost: 10 Qi Gems.
Effect: Increased odds of finding random Qi gems from slain monsters.
How to Obtain: Qi Gem shop.
[line]
[i]Pawsitive Reinforcement[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_PetGifts.png[/img]
Cost: 15,000.
Effect: Your pets are more likely to dig up better gifts once you've reached maximum friendship with them.
How to Obtain: Bookseller from Year 2 onward.
[line]
[i]Secret Codes for Arcade Machines[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_CheatCodes.png[/img]
Cost: 65,536.
Effect: You will start with more lives in Junimo Kart progress mode.

[i]Book of Carols[/i]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_Carols.png[/img]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Spiderbuttons/ButtonsExtraBooks/refs/heads/main/Button's%20Extra%20Books/Images/Book_JunimoScrap.png[/img]

How to Obtain: [spoiler]Random chance when digging up an artifact spot.[/spoiler]

[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
It is recommended that you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to adjust the config settings from within the game. The in-game config menu will provide descriptions for what each of the options do. You will be able to adjust book availability, which books are enabled, how much they cost, and how strong their effects are.

[size=5][b]Recommended[/b][/size]
If you don't like how cluttered your Special Items & Powers tab might get with all my books and whatever other modded powers you have, might I recommend another mod of mine, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url]? As an added bonus, you'll get custom pop-up messages and animation colours when reading my books!

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]
In the transition from version 2.7.0 to 3.0.0, I completely overhauled how I handle translations in my mod in order to reduce unnecessary string duplication and to reduce the workload for both me and translators in future versions. However, this means that any previous translation mods that were not included with my mod are no longer compatible. If my mod did include a translation previously, it has been carried over... somewhat. Along with the new translation system, I also decided to set up proper licensing for my mod and its Github repository. The previous translations were all done by volunteers who, in the previous absence of a license, retained full rights to their translations. In version 3.0.0, I changed the licensing for translation contributions to my mod (and [i]only[/i] translation contributions, not the whole mod itself) to the [url=https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mit/]MIT License[/url]. This required permission from every previous translation contributor. Those who gave permission had their translations carried over into the new version of the mod. Those who did not respond when I attempted to contact them have had their translations removed, as I legally cannot include them in the new license without their permission. Therefore:

[b]IF YOU ARE A USER WHO USES TRANSLATIONS:[/b] I am sorry, but there is nothing I can do about the translations that existed previously but are now missing in the new version until another volunteer translator offers new translations under the [url=https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mit/]MIT License[/url] or until the translator who provided the now-missing translations gets back to me with permission to include them.

[b]IF YOU ARE A TRANSLATOR WHO HAS CONTRIBUTED PREVIOUSLY:[/b] If you previously gave me translations for my mod and are surprised that they are now gone, that means you did not respond to my message here on Nexus Mods! Please read it and get back to me! Otherwise, we have already been in touch, and any translations [i]written by you[/i] have been carried over into the new version, and you understand that any further translation contributions of yours will be licensed under the terms of the [url=https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mit/]MIT License[/url]﻿. If anything is missing that should not be missing, please let me know! Some things might have slipped through the cracks in the transition.

[b]IF YOU ARE A TRANSLATOR WHO HAS NOT YET CONTRIBUTED: [/b]Know that by offering your translations to me, you are giving permission for them to be distributed under the terms of the [url=https://choosealicense.com/licenses/mit/]MIT License[/url]﻿. If you do not wish to license your translations this way, please feel free to upload your translation to Nexus separately, so long as you do not include other portions of my mod with it.

[b]HOW TO CONTRIBUTE A TRANSLATION: [/b]Ideally, you would submit a pull request on my Github found in the source code link below, but if you do not know how to use Github for that purpose or just don't want to deal with it like that, please make a thread on the Forums section of this mod page with your translation. If a language .json file exists in the mod for your language already, any text in need of translation will be marked with "/* TODO */" in front of it.
